text:
alex: CI alert - master build red. Failing test: runtime.SequenceReplayerTest::replays_in_order (intermittent). Fails ~1/20 runs on linux-x86_64-shared.
ci-bot: [build #65431] test failure: //runtime:sequence_replayer_test (see logs) URL: https://ci.internal/65431
maya: ack. triggering rerun now :arrows_counterclockwise:
maya: `bazel test //runtime:sequence_replayer_test --runs_per_test=20 --test_output=errors`
ci-bot: rerun started
lee: putting on my queue. any suspicious recent changes to SequenceReplayer or to scheduling/backoff code?
sam: I saw a PR that changed RetryScheduler sleep jitter (PR #4218) - could affect timings. Also SequenceReplayer uses unordered_map in debug-only path? not sure.
jordan: attaching minimal stack/log snippet from failing run:
```
--- FAIL: SequenceReplayerTest/replays_in_order (0.41s)
runtime/sequencer.cc:184: expected 42 got 37
stack:
  runtime/sequencer.cc:184
  runtime/thread_pool.cc:97
  runtime/sequence_replayer_test.cc:58
```
jordan: also reproducer: `TEST_REPEATS=100 ./bazel-test.sh //runtime:sequence_replayer_test`
alex: thanks. sam - can you try bisecting between PR 4205..4220? maybe use `git bisect run` with the test script.
sam: can do. quick check: is there any non-deterministic random seed in SequenceReplayer? I thought we seed deterministic in tests.
jordan: there's a global util::random_engine used without fixed seed in a helper. I can push a quick patch to set seed from gtest::GetRandomSeed() for tests.
maya: if it's timing-related, increasing runs_per_test might show frequency. I set rerun count to 50.
ci-bot: rerun finished: 1/50 failed. flake confirmed.
lee: @jordan please open WIP PR that pins RNG in test. also add `--runs_per_test=100` to CI for this target while investigating.
jordan: opened PR #4234 (WIP) with deterministic seed, small patch.
sam: starting `git bisect run ./bazel-test.sh //runtime:sequence_replayer_test` - will report back.
alex: if bisect points to RetryScheduler PR, we can revert or tweak jitter.
maya: FYI I'm adding a flaky test label to the test so it's excluded from strict gating until we fix. will coordinate with release manager.
jordan: quick log from local stress run with my seed fix: 0/100 failures so far. will add to PR tests.
sam: bisect narrowed to commit 5d9f7a6 (PR #4218) - RetryScheduler jitter change. replicable locally when running other tests in parallel.
lee: ok that explains timing interplay. Options: revert PR, make jitter less aggressive, or make SequenceReplayer robust to scheduling variability.
alex: prefer fix in scheduler to avoid changing test code semantics. but acceptable to make test less timing-dependent if necessary.
maya: next steps: (1) sam to propose minimal tweak to jitter (2) jordan to keep seed patch as backup (3) lee to monitor CI run with increased runs_per_test. target ETA today EOD.
sam: starting PR to tweak jitter coeff.
jordan: keeping my WIP PR for test determinism as fallback.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: mention: build status updated: master green after PR #4236 merged (jitter tweak)
maya: marking thread resolved.
